scripts.build: npm run build:client && npm run build:ssr
scripts.openapi-assets: mkdir -p public/api-doc/assets && cp node_modules/swagger-ui-dist/swagger-ui.css node_modules/swagger-ui-dist/swagger-ui-bundle.js node_modules/swagger-ui-dist/swagger-ui-standalone-preset.js node_modules/swagger-ui-dist/favicon-16x16.png node_modules/swagger-ui-dist/favicon-32x32.png node_modules/swagger-ui-dist/LICENSE node_modules/swagger-ui-dist/NOTICE node_modules/swagger-ui-dist/swagger-ui-bundle.js.LICENSE.txt node_modules/swagger-ui-dist/swagger-ui-standalone-preset.js.LICENSE.txt public/api-doc/assets/
scripts.test:ssr: npm run build:ssr && vitest run --config vitest.ssr.config.ts
scripts.check: npm run check:types && npm run lint && npm run check:inertia-v3 && npm run test:front:ci && npm run test:ssr && npm run test:e2e:browser && npm run format:check && npm run build
scripts.format: prettier "resources/**/*.{js,ts,svelte,css}" package.json package-lock.json tsconfig.json svelte.config.js eslint.config.js prettier.config.js vite.config.js vitest.config.ts --write
scripts.format:check: prettier "resources/**/*.{js,ts,svelte,css}" package.json package-lock.json tsconfig.json svelte.config.js eslint.config.js prettier.config.js vite.config.js vitest.config.ts --check
